newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices remained mostly flat to weaker on Monday in lackluster activity as dealers noted a softening in nearby demand.
"It appears to me that maybe we are beginning to see a fading in feed demand," a Buffalo dealer said, adding that there were some delays in feed ingredient shipments.

"Demand is off which is typical for this time of year," a St Louis dealer said. He noted in the deferred positions of October, November and December (OND), the premiums were marginal versus the nearby July, August, September quotes.
"This is a function of the big discounts of new crop corn and soybeans." That is part of the reason why there is no incentive to buy the forward positions, he said.
Usually OND's are about $10, $12, and $14 premium versus the July, August and September positions. "Why buy now if you cannot get it at a discount," he said.
Another dealer said the market was moving away from the short holiday weeks and the run time problems. "In theory, the market should drop as we go forward," he said.
